users_contact_chk.name: users_contact_chk
users_contact_chk.value: "users"."email" is not null or "users"."phone" is not null

quotes_target_chk.name: quotes_target_chk
quotes_target_chk.value: "quotes"."request_id" is not null or "quotes"."project_id" is not null

evidence_target_chk.name: evidence_target_chk
evidence_target_chk.value: "evidence"."task_id" is not null or "evidence"."milestone_id" is not null

reviews_range_chk.name: reviews_range_chk
reviews_range_chk.value:
("reviews"."workmanship" is null or "reviews"."workmanship" between 1 and 5) and
    ("reviews"."punctuality" is null or "reviews"."punctuality" between 1 and 5) and
    ("reviews"."communication" is null or "reviews"."communication" between 1 and 5) and
    ("reviews"."professionalism" is null or "reviews"."professionalism" between 1 and 5) and
    ("reviews"."quote_accuracy" is null or "reviews"."quote_accuracy" between 1 and 5)

provider_availability_chk.name: provider_availability_chk
provider_availability_chk.value: "provider_availability"."weekday" between 0 and 6 and "provider_availability"."start_minute" between 0 and 1439 and "provider_availability"."end_minute" between 1 and 1440 and "provider_availability"."end_minute" > "provider_availability"."start_minute"
